points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and tests are present; clean rebuild was not feasible from immutable recovery because benchmark inputs are intentionally not copied. Report wrapper path is defective.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven solve CLI and validation/error paths are implemented; historical evidence supports use, no fresh solver run performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Clear mesh, partition, halo, physics, numerics, output and solver modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable wrapper evidence; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Source reads case JSON and CGNS topology; no case-id or mesh-name production branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS K-way, Isend/Irecv neighbor halos, and Allreduce residual/force reductions are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Defensive geometry/state checks and positivity safeguards are present; no fresh memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Nine CTests and Python tests are submitted/claimed; validator and historical rank evidence verified.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ source; report-wrapper working-directory defect remains.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
